caste.heading: Estimated community composition
caste.disclaimer: Every figure here is an estimate. Electoral rolls do not record caste. These are derived from surname inference, Census 2011 proportions and booth surveys, at booth level only — never about any individual.

transfer.note: Lok Sabha figures are the Giridih assembly segment, not the whole parliamentary seat

booths.sortHint: Click a heading to sort; shift-click to add a second sort
booths.noMargin: Fewer than two candidates, so there is no margin.

candidates.heading: Candidates
candidates.noParty: No party recorded for this candidate.

localPolitics.heading: Local politics
localPolitics.name: Name
localPolitics.noTagSource: No source recorded for this tag.
localPolitics.untaggedHelp: No party tag has been assigned. This is not the same as standing as an independent.
localPolitics.tagCaveat: Panchayat polls are contested without party symbols. Any party here is a manual tag, not a published fact, and the source records who assigned it.
localPolitics.effectCaveat: The effect on a party is a judgement recorded by whoever logged the event, not a measurement.

casteScatter.heading: Community share against party share
casteScatter.fit: Least squares over {{n}} usable booths: slope {{slope}}, r = {{r}}. A weak r means the relationship barely exists in this data.
casteScatter.noFit: Too few usable booths to fit a line. Four is the minimum; a line through fewer is decoration.
casteScatter.excluded_one: {{count}} booth is drawn hollow and excluded from the fit: its community estimate is below the 0.4 confidence floor.
casteScatter.excluded_other: {{count}} booths are drawn hollow and excluded from the fit: their community estimates are below the 0.4 confidence floor.
